```plato
    // The degrees of freedom a support restrains, given that they are numbered
    // deflection first and rotation second: both for a Fixed end, the deflection
    // alone for Pinned and for Roller, none for Free. Pinned and Roller coincide
    // because this model carries no axial degree of freedom for a roller to
    // release.
    RestrainedDofCount(r: BeamRestraint): Integer
        => match (r)
        {
            Fixed => 2;
            Pinned => 1;
            Roller => 1;
            Free => 0;
        };
```
